notes.title: UPDATE 1.09 - Multiple Little Glitch Fixes, Nothing More, Nothing Less!
notes.content:
Hello all you "Pog Champs"!!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/df0aefb840a2ccbcce2f557ce85625cd9a2125ce.png"]



In this update, it was my 9 year old little nephew that found a bug his first ever time playing my Poggers game, a bug I had simply overlooked due to knowing it had once worked in the past, but never expected to not function correctly now after all the years of updates!



I watched as he put multiple Bun-Buns in the exact same cave with success.  This was never intended, and originally would kill your Bun-Bun if you tried to put him in the same cave as a previous Bun-Bun Poggers had already claimed.  ..I ruffled his hair playfully and thanked him for finding a glitch to fix for me and he smiled with a young childs satisfaction.



Now this little bug has been fixed as has other little silly glitches I noticed while observing him play my 2019 retro game...

The snake logs now face the appropriate direction and should never ever look as if they are swimming backwards with their eyes facing the wrong way.

Patches of grass should now not sometimes show up in front of the player or some snakes when multiple creatures are in the same small area of the game screen.

The "lives remaining" and "score" indicators should now only display once rather than looking like two of the same white reading as before.  This was unintentional as one of the two on each reading was intended to be the shadow to make it stand out better.

Rocks booted from the "Save Honey-Boo" level should now never leave the screen and hit their target UFO as intended.



Nothing super significant in this little update, but hopefully it makes the gameplay a little more enjoyable and fixes a few of the little quirks in the game overall.







Thanks for reading, and I hope you enjoy this game and any other games you might be playing!





Sincerely,



ZaxtorGameS .. (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.07 - The Alien Attack! - Brand New Level Content!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/0986ef26440ac82259cfd87619365f3e5a857a67.jpg

Hello fellow Pog Champs!

With Update 1.07, I've finally finished one of what I plan on several new content additions to my best selling and highest rated game here on Steam with good ol' Poggers!

This is a new level that will help change things up and presents you with a new challenge of saving HoneyBoo who has hidden under one of many rocks due to an Alien Invasion.  Is it real aliens attacking from the night sky or did Honeyboo find herself some alcohol somewhere?  Well, it doesn't matter much because she needs to be found wherever she is for your game progression to continue!

This new level will be seen up to seven times per game, coming after completing levels 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, and 19.  This will likely be changed when and as new content and levels are added to the game over the coming months.

-----------------

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/a76e850421d93c812a10c9c600e870c2ba8ca4fe.jpg

As seen in the comparison screenshots above, I've also changed a few minor details of the games look such as making the logs have a variety of different shades as well as making the shape of the home caves smoother overall.  

In this update, I've also made it so that you can always hit the TAB key to switch between windowed and full screen mode on every screen in the game,  Previously, the TAB key had no function on several of the screens such as the "Level Complete", the "Steam High Scores", and the "Stats" screens.

-----------------

As with any new content in an indie game like this, there will likely be a few bugs and/or balance issues that I might need to fix or update in the coming weeks and I will make note of such updates here as usual.  Please leave comments under this post or in the forums for this game should you have any new ideas, suggestions, or if you just happened to find a bug!

I hope that you enjoy saving HoneyBoo in this all new level and please share your thoughts and opinions after trying it out below!


Pog On!

Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS .. (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.06 - Poggers Now Moves 20% Faster Side to Side! - More Coming!!
notes.content:
In Version 1.06, I made some changes that I hope will make the base game so many of you love even more exciting and enjoyable!

* On the fields full of cobras, to help you catch up with the flashing cobras, escape cobras, and just get around faster, Bun-Bun now jumps side to side (left and right) 20% further!  This change will likely take some getting used to, but I think that it's a good change overall.  The movement and jump distance in all directions has not changed once you jump onto a log of alligator that is in the river.

* I've also cleaned up some of the home icons for Poggers once you get him into a cave when you own the 10 million colors DLC and have a unique blend of colors that would sometimes make your home Poggers look really bizarre before this update.

* The game now launches in full screen mode, and remember that you can switch between full screen and windows anytime by simply hitting your TAB key.

* Also in this update, I've cleaned up the look for the flashing "Total Super Bunny Points" once you died or ran out of Super Bunny points to make it look better overall.

* Silver Nuggets, Gold Nuggets and Carrots should now never appear under a rock.

That's it for this update, but in the coming week or two look for some HUGE updates that will add more game modes to this game!  Most of these modes will focus on saving your pink HoneyBoo girlfriend from a variety of deadly situations including giant spiders and alien spaceships as seen in this image:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/50130ff982a175d15d9ab39a174829e1b2fb77db.png

All additional content added to Poggers will be in hopes of making this game offer more excitement and fun and it will come at no additional cost!  ..Think of what will be coming as a "Thank you" for making the beloved "Bun-Bun Poggers" my most successful indie game to date!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.05 - The Top 1,000 High Scores + Steam Friends High Scores In The Game!
notes.content:
Poggers has already done better than I could ever have imagined that it would when I developed it back in 2019 because I was shocked that I couldn't find any indie version of old school 'Frogger' on Steam!  It was in that moment that I knew Steam HAD to have a new indie game inspired by the retro classic and that I could make it even more fun!  ..Poggers was born and developed in about three weeks and I never expected it to become my most beloved game at that time!

When I launched Poggers, I figured that 100 high scores would be more than enough for the life of the game.  Now, the game has over 800 high scores posted, only 200 of which can be seen from the Steam community page!  

...This update fixes that problem!

You can now see the TOP 1,000 High Scores ever posted in Poggers directly from the game, and you don't even have to play a game to see them!  From the welcome screen, you'll also see your highest score ever posted as well as where you stand in the rankings currently with that score!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/2d7640f9aa6911da30c6f6362b0bbb8d67d3b2f2.png


There's also never been a better time to encourage your friends and family to buy Poggers and do some good ol' friendly competition in the game to see who is the best at playing Bun-Bun Poggers!  You can easily see where you stand against your Steam friends now from the high score screen with a single click!  Your 'top 40' friends scores are available at any time from with-in the game!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/058bef85013261cad4a0021bf470a33766bd74a7.png


--- Fixes in this update:  ---------

* Fixed an issue with the peaceful game music not playing if the game was started from the High Scores screen

* Fixed an issue that would allow both the credits window and the How-to-Play window from being opened simultaneously

* Changed the code to make sure the Poggers "home" icons were the same color as your bunny if you own the "Ten Million Colors" DLC (and you have a lighter colored bunny color)

* Nerfed the chances of getting a gold nugget from breaking a rock in Super Bunny Mode (from 9% to 5% chance)

* Increased the chances of getting a silver nugget from breaking a rock in Super Bunny mode (from 9% to 12% chance)

-------------------------------------


As the developer of Poggers, I am committed to ensuring that he lives on!  The sequel "Poggers 2: A-Maze-Thing" is already in development and has a Steam page!  I am also planning some massive updates to this game to completely change the dynamics of the game!  ..Don't worry, this base game isn't going away, but new levels and objectives are planned so that you'll have new challenges to change things up as you progress through the game!

..The last few updates are only the beginning of what's in store for this "Poggers" game!


See you in the cobra fields!


Sincerely,  

ZaxtorGameS    (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 1.02 - Fixed the "Vigilante Bunny Cobra Vanquisher" Steam Achievement!
notes.content:
Super small update here to fix a long standing Steam achievement that I somehow missed that wasn't working as intended.

The old "Vigilante Bunny Cobra Vanquisher" Steam achievement before this update required you to kill every snake on a single level to obtain.  This was an achievement that was working as intended from the time the game launched in March of 2019 until Update 0.83 that came nine months later in December of 2019.  In Update 0.83, I made it so the cobras of a specific color would all re-spawn if every cobra of any color was killed off by you.  ..And I never changed this achievement until I just recently noticed it and fixed it during my lunch break tonight while working my real job..  =D

Anyhow, you can read about Update 0.83 if you'd like right HERE:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1039200/view/1683715349044976852


My fix tonight to resolve this is simply to change this now unobtainable achievement to..
"Vanquish 100 cobras with the Super Bunny attacks in a single game"


Super simple and small fix but I know this is probably huge to all the Steam achievement hunters out there!  I am sorry it took me so long to see this little problem and resolve it.

If there are any more problems you might witness while playing Poggers, please let me know in the forums or in the comments below this update!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS  (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.87 - Yellow Grass Snakes Don't Spawn Until Level 5!
notes.content:
Hello all!

The biggest change in this update is that the yellow grass snakes that you can't kill with carrots in the middle of the field have been removed from the game until you reach level 5.  If I get feedback on them, and enough people ask that they be removed from the game altogether, that is a possibility as well.  For now though, we'll just introduce them starting once you hit level 5.  I feel like this change will be a great way to help newer players avoid some frustrating deaths from those little yellow grass snakes and also give you a safe row in the middle of the field as well.

In this update, I fixed a small typo that would display your total carrot points as just 25 points if you actually score 153,575 total carrot points as I saw the issue in Classic Murdergarita's Poggers video uploaded on February 8th.  The points were correctly given in the game, it just incorrectly displayed how many points you scored with the carrot as just 25 points.  

The collisions with Poggers and the silver and gold nuggets has also been adjusted slightly to make collecting these a little easier than before.

That's just about it for update 0.87.

I still have plans to add additional levels and/or bonus levels to this game.. but with a full time job and raising my son and basically real life.. finding time to invest in coding has been a little bit of a struggle lately.  In the meantime, I hope you all are enjoying playing as BunBun Poggers!  =)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.86 - A Few More Rocks, Minor Adjustments
notes.content:
Just a small update that adds a small handful more rocks to each level and higher chance for more rocks as you advance in level. 

..With that, added checks when creating and placing the rocks on every level to be sure that there is always at least one clear path through the rocks from Poggers starting location to the river bank.

Other than that, made sure that the yellow grass snakes always appear behind any rocks they collide with.


REMEMBER THIS HELPFUL HINT:

You can press the 'R' key at any time to completely RESTART your game!  
..Be warned however it is an immediate restart of your game without verifying it with you and your level will immediately go to level 1 and your score will be 0 again!

Have fun Pog Champs!!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.85 - New "How To Play" Window, Collision Boxes of Rocks Fixed!
notes.content:
A small update is 0.85, but it fixed a game breaking issue found by my good friend MBCcompany where if you paused the game while floating on a river log, you'd end up falling off the log and drown!  Oh Nooo!  That can't happen to Poggers!  ..Bug found, squashed, and ridiculed for trying to mess with our dearest Bun-Bun!

This whole patch is pretty much dedicated to Mr MBCcompany who also suggested a "how-to" window with several pages and animations on each page, and while I didn't quite do the animations he suggested, I did make it much easier to read with lots of pretty pictures and less text!  (I figured even if I made a super cool 10 page "how-to" with cool animations that someone would come along and say "WTF, I don't wanna click next page 10 times!  Put it all on one page!")

MBC also found that some rock collisions would not allow Poggers to pass by a rock on the row directly under or directly over the rock.  I believe I fixed these collision boxes while still allowing plenty of opportunity to break the rocks with the Super Bunny power-up.

As always, feel free to let me know if the issues I fixed today ended up causing other problems elsewhere or if you just find a completely new bug!

Also feel free to leave your feedback, opinions or suggestions in the comments below or on the forums here!

Thanks for the help fixing these issues MBC...  and for the suggestion about the "how-to" as well!  ..Great stuff!  =)

Keep on Poggin' my fellow pog champs!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.84 - Bug Fixes, New Stats Level Complete Screens!
notes.content:
Update 0.84 brings a few bug corrections to Poggers, the big one being a fix to the Super Bunny target cobra sometimes being well off screen when a family of snakes re-spawned.  The family of cobras re-spawning is a completely new change recently made to Poggers to make sure that you always have more than enough butt to kick!   Making sure you have plenty of snakes felt like a good change with all the Super Bunny time you might acquire with the silver and gold also recently added to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/eea9d2a8bc59c0d7fc37ec5a5555ced0f707e345.png

Also in this update is all new level complete screens that give you more information than before, including how many cobras you killed on the past level, how many points they were worth.. as well as how many rocks you broke and how many points they added to your score.

A final stats screen will also give you the above stats but for your entire game and the final stat screen will also now give you an overall performance grade and tell you how well you did!

A lot of updates have been made to Poggers recently, and I genuinely feel it is a much better game now than it was just a week ago.  The recent spike in purchases on Steam is the reason I gave this game some love during this Christmas week.  I wanted to show my appreciation for all my recent customer support by giving something back in added value to this game so many people have been purchasing from me!

I hope that you enjoy all the recently added content to Poggers!  ..Please let me know below and if you do enjoy this game, I'd love it if you'd spread the word on social media outlets that you enjoy!  Also remember that leaving a review of your experience with my game will help others know what you like and don't like about Poggers!

Until the next update, stay safe out there and have a great holiday season!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.83 - There's SILVER & GOLD In 'Dem Rocks!
notes.content:
In update 0.83, silver and gold can be found in them rocks when you break them using your Super Bunny power-up obtained from eating a carrot, which carrots are obtained by getting your bun-bun home to a cave!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/2a50540f3b80ce960b7c4f38cd1fdaa88d3ce65b.png

When you are lucky enough to find a gold nugget and collect it, it will add anywhere from 12 to 20 seconds to your Super Bunny counter, allowing you to kick some cobra butt!  Hiyah!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/ac701f36cd7cf263e4f97c796dd72f9ef1923f1c.png

While finding a gold nugget is the real prize from busting up rocks as well as helping increase your maneuverability, silver nuggets have a greater chance of being discovered from a busted rock.  Silver nuggets work the exact same way as gold nuggets, but give less extension to your Super Bunny time when collected. 


Also in this update, the following changes have been made:

- Snakes will now re-spawn!  If you destroy all of the same color of cobra on the field below the river, they will be completely regenerated and they will be faster than they spawned initially!  Be wary!

- The Greenie water snake that you can use as a log in the river will now show a red outline if he is under water so far that you'll drown if you try and step on him.

- The code has been altered to allow getting the cobra "evasion" a little easier than ever before!  ..Not only does this help you escape with your life, but gives you a nice little 500 bonus points as well every time you pull the evasion off!  ..Don't get too greedy on trying those close calls though because those cobras are bound to get ya!


Here's a few information bits about today's new gold discovering update you might find useful:

- The maximum Super Bunny time is 40 seconds right now.  If you find a chunk of gold or silver and still have a lot of Super Bunny time, you can save them for later use (on the same level).

- The gold and silver nuggets do not disappear after a certain period of time like other power-ups.  Feel free to save them for when you need them. 

- If you try and collect a silver or gold nugget when you don't have Super Bunny, you'll be reminded that you need to eat a carrot before collecting the nugget.


As always, ENJOY!  ..and again, Happy Holidays!   =)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.82 - Hard Rock Comes To Poggers! ..Lot of Rocks, Not Music! Oh My!
notes.content:
The challenge increases in Poggers with rocks that will block and interfere with your maneuverability in the cobra fields in this update just in time for the Christmas holiday!

At level one, you'll only see a handful of rocks of assorted sizes and strengths randomly placed about the field:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/44fe206fc61db67284198860bc620ed3af9e407b.png

At level twenty however, you'll see that the number of rocks can create a real problem in a field that already presents lots of fast moving dangers:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/e158fc4ebf18223749a28b701cf8869db7e3a083.png

But Poggers can fight back!  The highly desirable carrots awarded for getting each bunny home to a cave give Poggers not only the power to avenge the deadly cobras, but now can also be used to break massive rocks into tiny little pieces!  HIYAH!  Flex them furry muscles Bun-Bun!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/86152729311812516cdb90ccd7a5a2c3998e68cd.png

Some notes about this new content:

- Points for breaking rocks can accumulate quickly, so it's a nice bonus to the already attractive ability to clear up the field to allow freedom of movement!

- Some rocks are stronger on one side than other sides.  Remember that you must collect a carrot and be in Super Bunny mode to have the strength needed to break the rocks!  Press against one side of the rock to attempt to break it and if you notice it changing to a reddish color, you know you're on getting close to a rock break up!  If pressing against one side of the rock doesn't work, try attacking it from another angle.

- If you have to leave a rock partially damaged due to the threat of cobras or because your Super Bunny power-up expires, it will stay damaged for a short time but slowly start regaining it's health from the life giving Earth underneath it.

- Be careful as sometimes the impact of a rocks explosion will knock your bunny backwards!

- Additional seconds have been added to both the Super Bunny and total time to deal with the rock obstacles.

- Destroying a rock rewards you both both points and time.  Each rock destroyed will give you a couple of seconds back to your Super Bunny time as well as 3 seconds to your level timer.


OTHER CHANGES MADE IN THIS UPDATE:

- Various graphical tweaks have been made to improve the overall look and feel of the game:
..When Poggers drowns at the top side of the river or at the bottom side, the water will no longer bleed into the caves or onto the river banks at the bottom.  
..The snakes on the river logs have now been separated to their own logs when there is more than one river cobra on a level, and these snakes have been given a random color shade each level.
- It should no longer be possible to jump into an already occupied cave to score a safe home bunny.
- Collisions with some of the snakes at the top side of the field have been corrected to prevent unintended deaths.


I hope you all enjoy this new content and remember that more levels which will give Poggers all new challenges are planned and currently being developed!  If you experience any bugs or problems with this new update, please feel free to let me know below or in the forums here.  As a solo developer, feedback in invaluable especially if it is given to me in a professional manner.

Thank you for reading this and HAPPY HOLIDAYS to YOU and yours loved ones!

ZaxtorGameS indie game developer

notes.title: UPDATE 0.81 - Major Timer Updates Changes Everything! Ya Better Get Moving!!
notes.content:
This update is coming later than I has hoped, as it was intended to follow upright after update 0.80 which increased the movement speed of Bun-Bun Poggers significantly.

While update 0.80 increased the movement speed of Poggers and I reduced the Super Bunny timer and the time adds for collecting a golden T, I never thought about needing to reduce the total time on the timer initially.  It didn't occur to me until I watched a Youtuber play the game and completely avoid killing snakes in a rush to just get all six rabbits home to the caves.  This was never an intended option for the player because killing the snakes was designed to be a big part of this game.

In an effort to almost "require" players to kill cobras to have enough time to get all six rabbits home, the following changes have been made in this update:

- The Total time at the beginning of a level has been reduced about about 45% of what it used to be.  (What used to be about 90 seconds at the start of a level on the timer is now about 50 seconds)

- The Total time given to you when you died has been adjusted to approximately 60 seconds but each rabbit you've already gotten home when you re-spawn will reduce this time given because you shouldn't need full time if you've already gotten one or more bunnies home.  The more rabbits you've gotten home when you re-spawn, the less time you'll get when you re-spawn after a death.

- A message letting you know about killing 3 snakes to get more time will be displayed 100% of the time on the first level in situations where you completely avoid eating a carrot to get a bunny home or when you eat a carrot but avoid killing at least three cobras.  After the first level, this message will be displayed only occasionally for the same situations.

- Moving a rabbit into a home cave position will reward you with an additional 5 seconds to the timer.

- Killing 6, 9, or 12 cobras with the same carrot "Super Bunny" power-up with reward the player with additional golden T's that can be collected to give you additional time on the timer.

- The river clock when green and collected has been reduced from a random 15 to 20 seconds to a random 10 to 15 seconds added to your timer.

- The river clock when red and collected has been reduced from a random 10 to 15 seconds to a random 5 to 10 seconds subtracted from your timer.

- The Super Bunny power-up gives you an additional 4 seconds to kill cobras for each carrot you eat.  (Remember that carrots are awarded for moving a Poggers into a home cave position)

- When you collide with a snake and die, the snake you collided with will now flash for a couple of seconds to let you see which snake killed you.

- As before, it is still impossible to have more than 99 seconds on the timer at any time.


This update as with all updates on all of my games has been made in an attempt to add both challenge and fun to this game.  Please feel free to let me know of any new bugs this update creates as well as how you feel about in general in the comments below!

Happy Holidays everyone!

ZaxtorGameS solo developer and Youtube content creator, Zaxtor99

notes.title: Update 0.80 - Poggers Moves 30% Faster!! Weeee!
notes.content:
I heard you loud and clear Breezy!  When I watched your steams and video on your Youtube channel, I decided that Poggers was indeed "just too darn slow" for a rabbit!  Poggers should now look and move much faster like you'd expect from a bunny rabbit!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34596120/f14912779f1686e250fae187b37427d51f1128ae.png

In this update, adjustments were made to the movement speed of Poggers!  He now moves 30% faster than before as a base increase and an additional 20% faster in "Super Bunny" mode!

This speed increase in movement speed should help players have more fun and also score higher scores than ever before!  If you have a high score posted before this update, you might just want to boot up Poggers soon and see if you can increase your old high score now that Poggers much much faster, especially after he eats a carrot and is in "Super Bunny" mode and flashing gold and white!

Remember everyone, that vanquishing three snakes after eating a carrot gives you the golden T which will help you add more time to your timer at the top!

Please be sure and check out the Twitch streamer "Breezy" at the link below as she is the first one who ever suggested that I should make Poggers move faster and more like a rabbit should!  Thanks for your suggestion and for streaming my game @ Breezy!

https://www.twitch.tv/breezybrmommy/


Additional changes in this 0.80 update:

- The new Super Bunny timer has been reduced by 20% because of the speed increases made to Poggers to make sure that plays aren't adding crazy amounts of like 102,400 per snake!  (Remember that bunnies vanquished while in Super Bunny mode double the score with each successive snake destroyed.. it adds up fast!)  

- A correction was made so that the "total cobras vanquished" counter in the bottom right of the game screen properly resets when you restart a new game.

- The yellow snakes found moving in the middle of the field have been redrawn.

- The size of the grass in the fields is now more randomized and taller than before.


Enjoy!  ..And please comment below and let me know how you like the new faster Poggers!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.77 - View High Scores From Welcome Screen Before Playing!
notes.content:
In this small update, I've added an option from the main welcome screen to view the Steam high scores without needing to play a game first.. to do so, simply press your ENTER key or click on the High scores box on the screen.

Also in this update, I've limited the Steam names to a maximum of 18 characters to prevent really long Steam names from bleeding into the high score, which looked very sloppy.  Now only the first 18 characters of all Steam names on the high score list will be shown.

That's it!

Enjoy Poggers!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.76 - Game Crashing Bug Fixed with Collision with Log Snake
notes.content:
I want to thank Steam user benjaminste for for reporting a critical game ending crash that occurred when he was doing really well with almost a million points and 6 lives remaining and collided with the yellow log snake.  At that point a game crash ended his great game, but thankfully he let me know in exactly the right place right away before he forgot about it!

I discovered that it only happened when you collided with the yellow log snake while you had the Super Bunny power up active.

This has now been fixed in this small but important patch.  Since the log snake will never be flashing as a target snake with Super Bunny, if you ever touch him, he will always kill you, but at least now the game won't abruptly end and you'll be able to continue as long as you have at least one more life!

..Thanks again for the proper report in my bug reporting thread to you benjaminste!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.75 - Top 1,000 High Scores Now Shown In Game!
notes.content:
Hello everyone..

In update 0.75, I've updated the high score end game screen so that you'll be able to see your score highlighted on the list in green and now the top 1,000 Steam scores will be shown on pages you can flip through with the F7 and F8 keys.  20 scores per page will be displayed here.

I've also added on real life photos of the infamous Poggers and the snakes mirrored around the high score list on the end game screen.

Other changes made in 0.75:

- Honey Boo will now have a MUCH lower chance of re-spawning on any level where you miss the opportunity to pick her up to take her home to a cave.  Also remember that once you collect Honey Boo and either kill her or bring her home for an extra life, she will never re-spawn on that same level.  ..You'll need to advance to the next level to see Honey Boo again.

- Made sure that the yellow snake(s) on the river logs don't move while the game is paused.

Other than that, I've adjusted some of the sound effects, most the new sounds added recently to balance them with all of the other sounds in the game..  to be descriptive, the "Poggers!" and "Pog Champ!" announcements when you get a rabbit into a home cave were lowered in volume.  Also the Honey Boo little melody and the carrot chomping sound volumes were reduced slightly.

Steam should be approving the increase in price from $1.99 USD to $2.99 USD in the next few hours, so LAST CHANCE to purchase Poggers for yourself or perhaps a friend before the price goes up! 

Have a great week everyone!  =)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.73 - New Indicators For Adding and Losing Time + More Sound Effects Added!
notes.content:
In this update, I've added indicators that will appear over Poggers head whenever he collects a yellow "T" that adds time or a river clock that can add or subtract time depending on its color.  The amount of seconds added or lost should now be much more visible.

A heartbeat sound is now heard whenever you have less than 15 seconds of time remaining to help you understand you need to hurry and finish the level or get a time add to avoid death.

A carrot crunching sound can now be heard when Poggers eats a carrot.

Also in this update, you'll now see the Super Bunny time will go up about two seconds every time you smash a cobra to help inspire you to keep smashing more before your Super Bunny timer expires.

Enjoy and happy cobra hunting!  =)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.72 - Scoring Changes, New Re-Start Option & Honey Boo Gets a Cool Entry Tune, More!
notes.content:
Okay, the first and most important reason for this update was to hopefully once and for all fix the dreaded death on contact with a flashing cobra glitch that I was almost certain I had fixed in update 0.70.  However when I came to my computer today Hibachi showed me video of it happening to him yet again well into his game after scoring a couple hundred thousand points!  ARGH!  The frustration!

..So I tested it here in this 9 hour long livestream:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e9os3rFPaLM

As seen in the video, the first time I tested Poggers trying to re-create the death on flashing cobra myself, it took me 233 successful collisions with flashing cobras before I died to it.  The next time, it was 130+ collisions.  This means that this issue is occurring at less than 1% of the time, but there is ZERO tolerance for this kind of a bug!  I HAD to fix this!

..I scratched my head.  And I applied a couple of different fixes hopeful they would fix this frustrating little annoying bug once and for all.

Since my last little desperate attempt to add some code to prevent this from happening again, I have easily had over 500 flashing snake collisions without a death.  This gives me some hope that I may have finally fixed this pesky little bug *knock on wood*


OTHER CHANGES MADE IN THIS LIVESTREAM AND IN UPDATE 0.70:

- Scoring changes!  

Your level completion bonus is now calculated as the number of seconds left on the timer when you complete the level multiplied by 100 points and then multiplying that by the level number you completed (previously 10,000 points multiplied by the level number you completed)

Moving towards the caves from your starting position will now score you 25 points multiplied by your current level (previously just 5 points per progressive move regardless of level)

Getting a Poggers bunny home now rewards you with 250 points multiplied by how many bunnies you've gotten home on the level and then multiply that by your current level (previously 100 points in the same formula)

Evasion scores have been increased from 50 points per evasion to 500 points (you'll see the word Evasion and +500 points on screen as well as hear a cartoon slip sorta sound when this occurs)


- Game Changes!

Pausing the game with the ESC key will now freeze ALL moving logs and creatures until you un-pause your game.  All power-ups on the screen when you pause will now be paused as well and will no longer disappear while your game is paused.

You can now press the 'R' key on your keyboard to immediately restart your game from the Paused Game screen.

The golden T timer power-up that spawns in the cobra field once you destroy three cobras with a single carrot Super Bunny will now add an addition 5 seconds to your timer  (The first one you collect on every level gives you 50 additional seconds, and each one collected after subtracts 5 seconds, so 50 seconds for the first one, 45 seconds for the second one collected on a level, 40 seconds for the third one, etc.  Keep in mind that 99 seconds is the maximum timer time at any given time)

The river power-up collectible now gives 15 to 25 seconds added to your timer if you collect it when it is green in color and subtracts 10 to 20 seconds from your time if you collect it when it is red in color  (previously 15 to 20 for green and -10 to -20 for red)  Keep in mind that 99 seconds is the maximum timer time at any given time.

The river creature that carries Honey Boo from one side of the screen to the other will now NEVER go under water if Honey Boo is on it's back.  (It has a heart and hates hearing her cry and gurgling death, but it will still go under water if YOU are on it's back so be careful!) 

You'll now see how many points you scored above the cave when you get a Poggers home to a cave at the top of the screen


- Audio additions!

Whenever Honey Boo enters the screen on a river creature, you'll hear a happy little melody letting you know she's available and wanting her hero Poggers to get her home to breed and give you an extra life! 

A pop sound will now be heard when the river timer collectible disappears

A new sound effect can be heard when you collect the river timer collectible


* Soon, I will be updating the high score list in the game to be more comprehensive and show ALL Steam high scores, not just the top 20 as it shows currently.

* A new median price will be charged for Poggers in the coming week or so.  I started Poggers at $3.99 USD on launch and then moved it to just $1.99 USD soon after.  Sales have been dismal for both price points, and lowering the price did NOT increase purchases.  A $2.99 USD price point I believe is more than fair considering the amount of work and heart I've poured into this little game and this change can be expected soon.  If you play and enjoy Poggers, please let your friends and loved ones know about it!

- I hope you all enjoy the changes and additions made to Poggers over the past few days and have fun in those high score challenges you're having out there with my game!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.70 - More Fixes Are In Plus NINE New Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
I want to personally thank Mellow Online1 and Hibachi for giving me a lot of valuable feedback the past couple of days to help make these past few updates which I know have made Poggers a much better and more solid game.

I cannot emphasize enough to everyone how important suggestions, ideas and the reporting of bugs you experience in these games is.  Especially for smaller indie games like Poggers here, a single developer like myself might never know about the problem you are seeing unless you make a post.  Ideas, suggestions, and all feedback can only help a developer make a game better so if you enjoy ANY indie game, please never be afraid to make posts in their forums and let them know!  Their game you enjoy will likely get even better and that indie developer(s) will be very appreciative of you posting the bugs for sure!

In update 0.70 the following problems were fixed:

- A mysterious collision bug that would sometimes result in the death of Poggers when you vanquished a flashing cobra while in Super Bunny mode has finally been fixed once and for all!  POG CHAMP! ..because this was indeed the biggest problem hurting this game since it launched and now it has finally been fixed!

- Fixed the wild "+50 point Evasion" problem that would sometimes give you evasions for no reason at all

- Made more room for your score at the top of the screen to prevent your score from being cropped if you score more than one million total points.  Now scores up to 99 million should be fully seen so play your hearts out @ Hibachi and Mellow!  ;-)

- Fixed the positioning of your rabbit if you got captured by a flying hawk so that you should now properly be seen being carried away in it's talons

- Added "Total Super Bunny Points: indicators for vanquishing:
 13 cobras with a single carrot (153,575 total carrot points), 
 14 cobras with a single carrot (204,775 total carrot points), 
 15 cobras with a single carrot (255,975 total carrot points), 
 16 cobras with a single carrot (307,175 total carrot points),
 17 cobras with a single carrot (358,375 total carrot points),
 18 cobras with a single carrot (409,575 total carrot points),
 19 cobras with a single carrot (460,775 total carrot points),
 20 cobras with a single carrot (511,975 total carrot points),
** These single carrot point totals aren't too likely but I do know hitting 153,575 is possible for smacking 13 snakes with a single carrot because I did it just tonight so I knew that I needed to add some more indicators! **

- Added THREE new Steam achievements for killing 13, 14 and 15 cobras with a single carrot

- Added SIX new Steam achievements for scoring 25,000 points, 50,000 points, 100k points, 200k points, 500k points, and One Million points in a game

- Lowered the volume of many sound effects to try and balance the game sounds against the background music

As always, please enjoy the game and keep me posted on all the bugs you experience as well as ideas, suggestions and your opinions of this game on my forums!  ..Have fun!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.66 - CRITICAL FIX TO 0.65 PATCH! TOP HIGH SCORES HAVE BEEN RESET!
notes.content:
It's never a fun decision to have to make when as a developer you need to go and reset any players high score in your game here on Steam.

My sincere apologies for deleting two high scores that came as a direct result of a mistake in my code made while trying to fix an issue in the recent update 0.65.

What happened?  

The mistake came trying to hot fix an issue where players would die while contacting the target snake while in Super Bunny mode (carrot power-up).  The mistake caused the player to be able to be invincible when contacting ALL snakes while in Super Bunny mode, not just the targeted snake.  This made it way too easy to always get maximum Super Bunny points with every carrot spawned and since there are five carrots per level, the points earned were just insanely high and unintended.

I've corrected the code to try and prevent accidental death while using Super Bunny mode and vanquishing the proper flashing cobra and reset the high scores that resulted from my mistake in update 0.65.  ALL OTHER HIGH SCORES THAT DIDN'T RESULT FROM THIS MISTAKE MADE IN UPDATE 0.65 HAVE BEEN LEFT ALONE.

Also in this update:

- Evasion +50 scores for narrowly escaping death from both cobras and hawks are now easier to achieve.  Are they worth "trying" to get when they require such narrow escapes (avoiding death by 3 pixels or less) to acquire?

- Hawks will now slowly increase in flight speed as you advance in level

- Prevented the crossbones from spawning in home caves once four or more caves have been filled with your Poggers bunnies

- Added a flash effect to the timers that appear over the river when the timer changes from red to green or from green to red.  Remember collecting a green timer adds to your time while collecting it while it is red subtracts from your time left.


That's it for this patch everyone!  =)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.65 - Several Fixes and Changes Including Easier To See Flashing Target Cobras With Super Bunny!
notes.content:
In this update, I've addressed some bugs reported by Hibachi on the forums and also found a few other issues and made changes to hopefully improve the overall experience with Poggers!  

In this update:

- A bug was stomped that sometimes caused no flashing target snake to be available when you ate a carrot and went into Super Bunny mode

- A bug was fixed that prevented you from being rewarded with the "Vigilante Bunny Cobra Vanquisher" Steam achievement for destroying every cobra on the screen on a single level

- You should now properly be rewarded with the "Achieved Level 2", "Achieved Level 5", and "Achieved Level 10" Steam achievements for making it to these levels

- Fixed an issue that would cause no carrots, hawks, or Honey Boo the pink female bunny to spawn if you ever paused the game and then resumed the game.  The pause feature should now work as intended without risk of sabotaging the game

- Fixed an issue that would allow a player to collect a carrot and race the bunny home to a cave, and then collect a new carrot to cause TWO target bunnies on the screen during the Super Bunny power ups

- Fixed an issue that would sometimes cause your bunny to die when smashing the proper target snake while in Super Bunny mode

- The look of the target cobra is now much easier to recognize whenever you are in Super Bunny mode after eating a carrot

- You'll now be rewarded with bonus points for completing each level.  This score will be shown after you complete a level (filling all six caves at the top of the screen with Poggers bunnies).  The score is 10,000 points multiplied by the level you just completed (ie 10,000 points for completing level 1, 20,000 points for completing level 2, 30,000 points for completing level 3 and so on..)

- Movement should be a little faster and more responsive as I've reworked the code and increased the speed on the bunny jumping animations slightly

- The cobra rage (speed increases of the same colored snakes when you destroy a snake with Super Bunny) has been reduced

- Crossing the river should now be a little easier as I've fixed some of the jumping onto log situations that would previously have resulted in splashes and death cries from Poggers.  You'll now notice that Poggers can jump onto the very end of a log and be safe with some of his body hanging over the end.

- The large logs in the middle of the river should no longer touch or collide with each other


With this update, there has been a lot of little issues and changes made and these changes have not been thoroughly tested yet.  PLEASE use my bug reporting thread on the forums for this game to post any new problems, bugs, or anything that you might find wrong.  Sometimes fixing little bugs causes other little problems or even bigger issues such as a game breaking fatal error etc.  

Thanks for reading this and I hope you like the changes I've made in this update!  Let me know with a comment below!  =)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.64 - Poggers Now Shows Top 20 High Scores In The Game Over Screen
notes.content:
This is great news and something that I've wanted to implement into my other Steam games in the past but never could quite figure out.

Tonight, I finally broke the ice.. and as usual - it was a silly little thing I was over looking preventing me from being able to show the overall high score list in my previous Steam games.

For now, it simply shows your score at the Game Over screen and shows you the top 20 high scores and Steam user names who scored them.  You'll know what score you need to achieve to put yourself at whatever top 20 spot you might strive for.  In the near future, I intend to enhance this to show more detailed information and also offer you the ability to compare your score to your personal Steam friends and more.

..Also, expect to see this feature in all of my previous Steam games Rock 'N Roll, Laser Ball, and FAN'CIE VEER! soon!

The following changes were also made to Poggers in update 0.64:

1) The human facial "poggers" facial expression has been removed and replaced with an emotional bunny rabbit face when you get a bunny home to a cave.

2) Visual changes have been made to the introduction screen to make it look more clean and polished.

3) The rage speed of all same color cobras has been increased whenever you vanquish a cobra with the carrot 'Super Bunny" attack.  This has also been better explained in the "How to Play" instructions accessed from the introduction screen.

4) Sometimes the yellow cobra on the big log in the river would be seen momentarily moving on the water instead of the log.  This has been fixed.

5) Jumping while on a river log will now be be smaller, safer, and more predictable sized jumps than before.

6) Your bunny will now make a splat visual effect if you smack into a wall instead of jumping into an available open cave.

7) The flying hawk can no longer grab you if you've just spawned a new bunny.  Be careful however as you only have two seconds to move if the hawk happens to fly right over your spawn location!

8) The +50 point evasion bonus now happens a little more frequently than before, but still shouldn't be too easy to full off and usually involves risky and very dangerous movement around the cobras.

9) The small logs in the river have had the small green leaves removed as some people commented that they could see the river through the logs.  This was not the case, what was though of was see-through river water was actually green leaves, but they were so small it made it hard to see.  The small logs should now look more "solid" and less "see through" in parts.


Thanks for reading and/or playing "Poggers" and I hope you are enjoying it!  =)
